subject: Temporary PO-exempt path request for NimbleWorks pilot - decision matrix and next steps
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@nimbleworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@nimbleworks.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding question — short-term billing path for pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to kick off the 3-month professional services pilot (SOW attached) but hit a snag with our procurement team: they prefer issuing a Redwood PO for all engagements, while our finance workflow for pilots routes through an invoice-only cadence (no PO) until a contract is executed in full.

Is there an established temporary path at Redwood for invoice-based pilots (essentially a short-term PO exemption)? If so, what evidence do you need from us (W9, SOW, insurance limits, etc.), and how long does the exemption typically last?

We’re aiming to start August 17 and would like to avoid delaying onboarding by waiting for the full PO process. Appreciate any guidance — I’ve attached the proposed SOW and can loop in finance if helpful.

Attachments: NimbleWorks_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)

Best,
Alex Chen
Head of Integrations, NimbleWorks
alex@nimbleworks.com
+1 415-555-0132
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — short-term billing path for pilot

Hi Alex — thanks for the SOW and the quick turnaround.

Short answer: yes — we have a conditional temporary lane we can open for pilots in cases like this, but it requires limited approvals and an evidence package. I’m looping in Rishi (finance) and Priyom (procurement) to confirm the thresholds and the operational steps.

To move fast, please send the following this week:
- Completed onboarding form (I’ll attach a short link below)
- W9 and company legal name + tax ID
- Liability insurance certificate (if available)
- Confirmation of anticipated monthly spend during the pilot (ballpark is fine)

Rishi — can you confirm whether finance is comfortable with a 30-day net invoice path for a capped pilot?
Priyom — if procurement is OK, can you open a temporary PO-exempt lane and confirm any dollar caps / review cadence?

If we get those items by Thursday, we can enable the invoice path and confirm start date for Aug 17. I’ve attached our PO-waiver checklist for your reference.

Attachments referenced: PO_Waiver_Risk_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 24 KB)
Quick onboarding form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1onboard-form-marissa

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — short-term billing path for pilot

Thanks for the loop, Marissa.

Finance is generally okay with a short-term invoice-only route for pilots, provided we have:
- W9 and legal entity confirmation
- A signed SOW that explicitly limits liability and spells out deliverables
- A clear spend cap (recommend <= $25k for an initial pilot)
- A 30–60 day review checkpoint to evaluate contractization

If those are present, we can process net-30 invoices and mark the account with a temporary PO exemption flag that triggers the review cadence. Priyom — procurement will need to accept the flag in the system and confirm how we enforce the cap operationally.

I’d suggest Marissa confirm the anticipated invoices schedule (weekly vs monthly) so we can set expectations with accounts payable.

–Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@nimbleworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — short-term billing path for pilot

Hi Alex / Marissa —

Procurement can support a temporary PO-exempt onboarding lane for NimbleWorks with the following controls in place:
1) Hard cap on spend of $25,000 for the pilot period (automated flag in vendor master).
2) Evidence package: W9, signed SOW, certificate of insurance (or confirmation of limited risk).
3) 60-day review from the start date (we’ll re-evaluate for PO issuance at the checkpoint).
4) Invoices must be routed to billing@redwood.com and include the Redwood account code (I’ll send the code once vendor intake is complete).

Marissa — once the onboarding form is submitted and the evidence package is uploaded to the vendor intake link, I’ll create the temporary exemption and share the vendor master record id. Alex — please confirm you can send initial invoices monthly, and we’ll convert to net-30 once the vendor record is live.

Attaching the checklist we’ll use internally.

Attachments: PO_Waiver_Risk_Checklist.xlsx (same as above)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0277
